reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: Very lightweight, almost water-like oil cleanser. It’s okay, but it does soften sebum. Use before sebum extraction for best results.
reviews.zh: 非常輕盈，質地幾乎好似水一樣嘅卸妝油。OK 嘅，不過佢可以軟化皮脂。喺清黑頭之前用效果最好。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: Me gustó mucho este es el tercer aceite de limpieza que pruebo y me gustó bastante siento que no es muy aceitosos y me gusta que saca mucho los puntitos blancos y negros que tenemos entre los poros la verdad si lo recomiendo prove el de Anua y el de manyo y siento que el de manyo está mas pesado y si tienes que enjuagarlo con agua tibia pero este al estar menos pesado lo puedes enjuagar hasta con agua normal
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款，呢個係我試嘅第三支卸妝油，感覺好滿意，唔算好油，仲可以清到毛孔入面嗰啲白頭黑頭。真心推薦，我試過 Anua 同 manyo 嗰兩款，覺得 manyo 嗰支比較厚重，要用暖水先沖得甩；但呢支冇咁厚重，用普通水都沖得甩。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: I’m really impressed with the Ilso Natural Mild Cleansing Oil. It’s lightweight, effective at removing makeup and impurities, and gentle on my sensitive skin. The 200mL bottle, plus the bonus 30mL, offers great value. It rinses off easily, leaving my skin clean and soft without any dryness. A perfect addition to my skincare routine!
reviews.zh: 我對 Ilso Natural Mild Cleansing Oil 真係非常滿意。質地輕盈，能夠有效卸除彩妝同污垢，而且對我嘅敏感肌好溫和。200mL 支裝加送 30mL，抵用。沖洗容易，洗完皮膚乾淨柔軟，唔會覺得乾。完美加入我嘅護膚程序！

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: Super thin oil cleanser, I'm more of a DHC oil cleanser fan aka thicker oil cleansers however this does the job well. Light fragrance that smells good. Pretty packaging
reviews.zh: 超薄身嘅卸妝油，我自己比較鍾意 DHC 卸妝油嗰種厚身啲嘅質地，不過呢支都做得唔錯。淡淡香味，幾好聞。包裝幾靚。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: This is my second purchase, and I am already on my way to my third. I'm sticking to this oil cleanser until a better one comes, but how would I know? I am not even trying other oil cleansers anymore. This is just perfect for me.
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第二次回購，已經準備買第三次。除非有更好嘅出現，否則我都會一直用呢支卸妝油，但點知有冇更好呢？我已經唔再試其他卸妝油。對我嚟講，呢支已經係完美。

reviews.text: 2nd time purchasing this. No doubt, it is a daily staple in my skincare routine. Barely scented, effective cleansing and makeup removal using minimal product. Perfectly preps my skin for a second gentle cleanse or if I am feeling lazy, leaves a light moisture behind. Perfect
reviews.zh: 第二次回購。毫無疑問，佢已經係我每日護膚程序中嘅必需品。幾乎冇香味，用量好少就有效清潔同卸妝。完美咁幫皮膚做好準備做第二次溫和清潔，或者如果我懶嘅時候，佢會留低一層薄薄嘅保濕感。完美。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text: This is so good that I immediately emptied the bottle and ordered another one. It is now my top favorite oil cleanser! Super love it. It just suit my skin so much. It is not stripping and provides just the right amount of moisture. I also love the subtle smell it has. Simply gorgeous product.
reviews.zh: 好用到我即刻用完成支再訂咗第二支。佢已經係我最愛嘅卸妝油！超級鍾意。完全夾到我嘅膚質。唔會帶走過多水分，剛剛好提供適量保濕。我都好鍾意佢淡淡嘅香味。簡直係完美嘅產品。

reviews.shade: ilso Natural Mild Cleansing Oil 200mL Special Set (+30mL)
reviews.text:
Bought it after seeing a recommendation by Arang. I have normal-dry sensitive skin. 

It's a watery oil cleanser so it goes on really easily and lightly on the face. I like to use it with another cleanser so I can't say much for cleansing power on its own. However, it does feel very moisturizing as my face doesn't feel as tight and dry as it usually is when I used my gel cleanser alone (thank god bc I was about to toss that gel cleanser). Didn't irritate my skin either. It does have a faint scent which smells really nice imo and I tend to hate scents.
reviews.zh: 睇完 Arang 推薦之後買嘅。我係中乾性敏感肌。佢係水狀嘅卸妝油，所以上臉非常輕透易推。我會配合另一支潔面產品一齊用，所以單用嘅清潔力我唔敢講。但佢真係好保濕，因為我塊面冇以前淨用 gel cleanser 嗰陣咁緊繃同咁乾（謝天謝地，我本來想掉咗支 gel cleanser）。亦都冇刺激到我塊面。佢有淡淡嘅香味，我自己覺得幾好聞，雖然我通常都唔鍾意有香味嘅產品。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
